source: Lowy Institute Poll — satisfaction with the direction of the world

waves.method: Nationally representative polling by Social Research Centre, combining telephone and online responses among Australian adults aged 18+.
waves.question: And turning to the situation in the world overall, are you satisfied or dissatisfied with the way things are going in the world today?
waves.sourceLabel: In 2017, 79% said dissatisfied; In 2017, 19% said satisfied.

waves.method: Mode blend: 600 online responses from Life in Australia (5–19 March) and 600 telephone respondents (7–25 March), weighted and blended.
waves.sampleNote: 600 online respondents + 600 telephone respondents; dual-frame landline and mobile sampling, with state/territory location quotas.
waves.question: And turning to the situation in the world overall, are you satisfied or dissatisfied with the way things are going in the world today?
waves.sourceLabel: In 2018, 78% said dissatisfied; In 2018, 17% said satisfied.

$comment: Global satisfaction by Lowy Institute, not Roy Morgan's Australia-specific direction or Ipsos' Global Average directions. Preserve distinct wordings and mode-era boundaries. Other is the derived remainder for the combined Don't know / no view / neither category, never an independently measured neutral or Unsure share. Not for pooling with other pollsters.
